  "memo":"R03 holds: the GB-issued card was used from a US IP and AVS failed. Card is the only adverse family; all other rule conditions are unmet. No household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles this order. The applicable evidence row is §6.6(b), but the failed id_check now decides under §5.3(b): decline is standard, and escalation is prohibited without Linkage. A legitimate new customer using a foreign card is plausible, but does not override the check failure. The order is unshipped and uncancelled; decline voids and refunds it and blocks the account. No further check is needed. This recommendation is advisory."
